contexts.text: When (the Most Ancient Church) expired.
Everything that is in the earth shall expire ()... It is their expiration or suffocation (which is meant).
All flesh creeping upon the earth expired () = that those who were of the last posterity of the Most Ancient Church were extinguished. AC 805:2, Explained.
After the former (Spiritual Church) had expired... Sarah, here, = the truth Divine which had expired. AC 2902.
When all faith, that is, charity has expired...
Abraham expired and died () = the end of the representation by Abraham. To expire, and die = to cease or have an end.
Isaac expired and died () = exsuscitation in the Divine Natural.
(Jacob) expired () = new life there... To expire or die = new life.
If the life of Hell with a man were suddenly destroyed, he would completely expire; and if the life of Heaven were suddenly implanted, he would also expire.
From Hell there continually breathes forth... HH 591.
Even from sand it breathes forth.
From the expiration of exhalations from plants...
In a loud voice, he blew out...
All love with man breathes forth delight...
Every particle of dust or powder breathes forth from its essence a subtle something...
He expires in the ruins.
I felt something within me like an expiration of air.
The love of self breathed forth with them.
I have gathered their breath, he expired ().
She who hath borne seven shall languish and breathe forth the soul () = that the Church to which all truths have been given will perish. AE 721:7.
To expire () = to exist no longer.
